question: Pri Z-BOXe od Packety netreba nič ťukať do samotného boxu, schránku otvoríte aplikáciou v mobile, keď stojíte priamo pri ňom. Cez akú bezdrôtovú technológiu sa telefón s boxom spojí?
source_excerpt: The app will automatically pair with your parcel box, which you open using the button in the parcel detail.

extra.why_interesting: Many Slovaks have used a Z-BOX without wondering how the phone talks to it. Most would guess the internet or a QR code. The answer is a short-range link, which also explains why you have to stand right next to the box.
extra.verification_notes: Packeta's official Z-BOX page says to turn on Bluetooth and location, open the app, and it pairs automatically with the box; I found no sign this has changed.

explanation: Telefón sa so Z-BOXom spojí cez Bluetooth, ktorý má dosah len pár metrov. Preto si balík neotvoríte z gauča doma, ale musíte stáť priamo pri boxe.

question: Pod nápisom Amazon na krabiciach je oranžová šípka, ktorá vyzerá ako úsmev. Od ktorého písmena po ktoré v názve vedie?
source_excerpt: Arrow from a to z communicates that Amazon sells everything. Smile shape reinforces Amazon's commitment to customer satisfaction.

extra.why_interesting: Everyone has seen the smile on Amazon parcels, but most people take it only as a smile. Once the player hears the question they can check the word in their head and reason it out, and the hidden meaning lands as a small 'aha'.
extra.verification_notes: The Amazon logo arrow runs from 'a' to 'z' and forms a smile, per the designer Turner Duckworth (https://turnerduckworth.com/work/amazon); no newer change invalidates it.

explanation: Šípka vedie od A po Z, lebo Amazon chce predávať všetko od A po Z. Pritom začínal ako obyčajné internetové kníhkupectvo.
